newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Beirut placement 11 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Beirut placement 11 times oversubscribed.

text.p: A private share placement by Lebanon's Bank of Beirut, which will shortly list 30 percent of its shares on the Beirut Stock Exchange, was 11 times oversubscribed according to a statement issued on Wednesday.
Middle East Capital Group (MECG), a Beirut-based finance house which acted as Arranger and Placement agent, said the oversubscription was a record for Lebanon.
The shares were priced at $2.17 each, reflecting the heavy over-subscritpion, MECG said in the statement.
The $10.4 million placement representing 20 percent of the bank's shares "was approximately 11 times oversubscribed, a record for Lebanon," it said.
"The strong demand by investors in the Bank was mainly from Lebanon and the region. The very heavy participation in the subscription involved over 600 institutions and individuals," it added.
It said the oversubscription resulted in smaller than anticipated allocations of shares but gave no details. Bank of Beirut had already begun refunding unallocated funds, it added.
The proceeds of the placement are to be re-injected as a cash contribution to capital on behalf of all the bank's shareholders, raising capital to $26-27 million.
Listing of 30 percent of the bank's shares -- the maximum allowed under a 1996 law, is expected in the next few days.
